We have been a leader in urban real estate development, property management, consulting and more since 2003.
Setting the Standard for Urban Development

Boston Residential Group has been redefining the art of urban living since 2003. From Newbury Street to the Navy Yard, our projects give customers an immediate and compelling connection to the city. Creating residences and amenities that blend seamlessly into the neighborhood, Boston Residential Group is at the forefront of urban development.

Boston Residential Group develops distinctive properties in partnership with institutional investors. From landmark condominium conversions in Boston’s Back Bay to transformative workforce housing in Dudley Square, our market insight translates into enduring real estate assets and superior financial returns.

Boston Residential Group’s carefully selected collaborators include industry leading architects, interior designers, construction managers, and engineering firms. Our teams work together to develop each project’s unique vision and deliver it to the market.

Led by Curtis R. Kemeny, our team blends extensive local market knowledge with innovative design vision. Whether bringing 40 units to Fort Point or 200 to Jamaica Plain, we infuse every property with design details that make it stand out in the market. From the carefully selected hardware in 360 Newbury to the exposed beams at 381 Congress to the park-side pool at Olmsted Place, we create uniquely beautiful properties.

Boston Residential Group manages a diverse portfolio of apartment and condominium developments with uncompromising reliability and exacting standards. Our attention to detail and team of experts results in higher than average occupancy rates and tenant turnover rates that are half the industry standard.

Boston Residential Group partners with large, publicly-traded financial institutions to develop properties that redefine urban living. Our market insight and crisp execution skills have helped us deliver a long track record of rock-solid returns for our investors. Boston Residential Group been involved with the development and management of over 2,000 units representing $1.0B in real estate assets. Our seasoned team works tirelessly to add value to our projects and is committed to providing superior returns to our investors.

CEO and President of Boston Residential Group

Founded in 2003 by Curtis R. Kemeny, Boston Residential Group has been involved with the development and management of over 2,000 units valued at $1.0B. Boston Residential Group’s seasoned team includes experts in real estate finance, development, construction and management. Mr. Kemeny serves as President and CEO. He received a BA from Dartmouth College in 1984 and an MBA from Harvard Business School in 1989.
